sections.title: 10.2 What LLMs CANNOT Do Well
sections.body:
### 1. Hallucinations (The Biggest Problem!)
> **LLMs sometimes confidently make up false information.**

```
User: "What did Barack Obama say in his 2019 speech at Harvard?"
LLM:  "In his 2019 Harvard speech, Obama said [makes up a convincing 
       but completely fabricated quote]..."

Problem: Obama may not have given that speech! The LLM invented it!
```

**Why it happens:** LLMs predict the NEXT LIKELY word. A convincing-sounding fake is more likely than "I don't know."

**How to mitigate:**
- Always ask for sources
- Use RAG to ground answers in real documents
- Use lower temperature for factual tasks
- Implement fact-checking layers

### 2. Knowledge Cutoff
```
LLM Training Data ended: January 2024
                              ↓
LLM knows nothing about:
  ❌ Events after January 2024
  ❌ Current stock prices
  ❌ Today's news
  ❌ Latest software versions

Solution: Use tools (web search), RAG, or real-time data APIs
```

### 3. Cannot Learn from Conversations (Stateless)
```
Session 1: "My name is John"  → LLM: "Nice to meet you, John!"
[Session ends]
Session 2: "What's my name?"  → LLM: "I don't know your name."

Problem: LLMs don't remember between sessions!
Solution: Store conversation history and include it in context
```

### 4. No Real-Time Data
```
LLMs CANNOT (without tools):
  ❌ Browse the internet
  ❌ Check current weather
  ❌ Read live stock prices
  ❌ Access your database
  
Solution: Function Calling / Tool Use (Module 11!)
```

### 5. Math & Precise Calculations
```
LLM on math: Treats numbers as WORDS/TOKENS, not numbers!

"What is 387 × 924?"
LLM might get: 357,438 (wrong!)
Correct answer: 357,588

Solution: Use tool calling with a calculator function!
```

### 6. Consistency Issues
```
Ask same question twice → May get different answers
(Especially with higher temperature)

Solution: Temperature = 0, or use structured output/validation
```

### Full Limitations Summary

| Limitation | Impact | Solution |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| **Hallucinations** | False info presented confidently | RAG, grounding, validation |
| **Knowledge cutoff** | Outdated information | Web search tools, RAG |
| **No memory** | Can't remember past sessions | Store & inject chat history |
| **No real-time data** | Can't access live data | Function calling |
| **Weak math** | Calculation errors | Calculator tools |
| **Inconsistency** | Different answers each time | Low temp, structured output |
| **Bias** | Reflects biases in training data | Careful prompting, filtering |
| **Context limit** | Can't process unlimited text | RAG, chunking strategies |
| **No actions** | Can't DO things (by itself) | Agents + function calling |
